title: Agent Output Display
description: Display surface schema for agent output rendering. Controls visual formatting: list styles, thresholds, separators, containers, and inline formats. Independent of both structure and content. Three sections (output, writing_output, return_format) have no display knobs.

identity.title: IdentityDisplay
identity.description: Display formatting for the identity section. Format and threshold pair for the expertise list.

role_expertise_format.title: IdentityRoleExpertiseFormat
role_expertise_format.description:
How the expertise list renders. Plain string means always that format. Two-element array means threshold-based switching: first element above threshold, second at or below. Threshold is identity_expertise_format_threshold.
Polymorphic format field. A plain string enum value means always use that format. A two-element array means threshold-based switching — first element above threshold, second at or below. Type tells behavior: string = unconditional, array = conditional.

role_expertise_format_threshold.title: IdentityRoleExpertiseFormatThreshold
role_expertise_format_threshold.description:
Item count threshold for expertise format switching. When identity_expertise_format is a pair, items above this count use the first format, items at or below use the second.
Whole number value

security_boundary.title: SecurityBoundaryDisplay
security_boundary.description: Display formatting for the security boundary section. Path style, toolset formats, intro threshold, and entry list format.

path_style.title: SecurityBoundaryPathStyle
path_style.description:
How filesystem paths render in display entries. Controls whether paths show as relative with ./ prefix, relative bare, or absolute.
How filesystem paths render in agent-facing output. 'relative_dotslash' strips the workspace prefix and prepends ./ (e.g., ./src/main.py). 'relative_bare' strips the prefix with no ./ (e.g., src/main.py). 'absolute' renders the full absolute path as-is.

toolset_format.title: SecurityBoundaryToolsetFormat
toolset_format.description:
How tool names render alongside paths in display entries. Engine detects whether tools are uniform or heterogeneous from the data. 'grouped' only applies when uniform — falls back to per_entry_list for heterogeneous tool sets.
How tool names render in security boundary display entries. 'grouped' shows the tool list once above all entries (only valid when all entries share the same tools — engine falls back to per_entry_list otherwise). 'per_entry_list' shows tools as a list alongside each entry. 'per_entry_prose' embeds tools in natural language alongside each entry.

filesystem_permissions_label_visibility_.title: SecurityBoundaryFilesystemPermissionsLabelVisibilityThreshold
filesystem_permissions_label_visibility_.description:
Entry count threshold for showing the filesystem map intro line. When entry count is at or below this threshold, the intro is suppressed (too few entries to need introduction). Above the threshold, the intro renders.
Whole number value

entry_list_format.title: SecurityBoundaryEntryListFormat
entry_list_format.description:
Marker style for the display entry list. Controls whether entries render with bullets, numbers, or dashes.
Marker style for list entries. 'bullet' uses bullet point markers. 'numbered' uses sequential integers. 'dash' uses dash markers.

input.title: InputDisplay
input.description: Display formatting for the input section. Context list format and parameter list format with threshold switching.

context_required_format.title: InputContextRequiredFormat
context_required_format.description:
Format for rendering the required context reading list. Numbered implies reading order. Bulleted implies unordered set.
How a list of items renders visually. 'bulleted' uses dash or bullet markers. 'numbered' uses sequential integers. 'inline' joins items on one line with a separator. 'prose' flows items as natural language. 'bare' renders items with no markers or joining.

context_available_format.title: InputContextAvailableFormat
context_available_format.description:
Format for rendering the available context resource list.
How a list of items renders visually. 'bulleted' uses dash or bullet markers. 'numbered' uses sequential integers. 'inline' joins items on one line with a separator. 'prose' flows items as natural language. 'bare' renders items with no markers or joining.

parameters_format.title: InputParametersFormat
parameters_format.description:
Format for rendering the parameter list. Prose for small lists (1-2 parameters), bullets for larger lists. A pair switches at the threshold.
Polymorphic format field. A plain string enum value means always use that format. A two-element array means threshold-based switching — first element above threshold, second at or below. Type tells behavior: string = unconditional, array = conditional.

parameters_format_threshold.title: InputParametersFormatThreshold
parameters_format_threshold.description:
Parameter count threshold for format switching when parameters_format is a pair. At or below this count the second format applies; above it the first format applies.
Whole number value

critical_rules.title: CriticalRulesDisplay
critical_rules.description: Display formatting for the critical rules section. Inline format for workspace path, tool name, and batch size. Tool name repetition strategy and rule separator.

workspace_path_format.title: CriticalRulesWorkspacePathFormat
workspace_path_format.description:
How the workspace path renders inline in critical rules prose. 'backtick' wraps in code backticks. 'plain' renders as-is. 'bold' wraps in markdown bold.
How a single value renders inline. 'backtick' wraps in code backticks. 'plain' renders as-is. 'bold' wraps in markdown bold. 'metadata' renders as a key-value label (e.g., "Batch size = N").

tool_name_format.title: CriticalRulesToolNameFormat
tool_name_format.description:
How the output tool name renders inline in critical rules prose. 'backtick' wraps in code backticks. 'plain' renders as-is.
How a single value renders inline. 'backtick' wraps in code backticks. 'plain' renders as-is. 'bold' wraps in markdown bold. 'metadata' renders as a key-value label (e.g., "Batch size = N").

tool_name_repetition.title: CriticalRulesToolNameRepetition
tool_name_repetition.description:
How the tool name is referenced after first mention. 'repeat' uses the full name every time. 'shorthand' defines once then uses "the tool" for subsequent references.
How a tool name is referenced after first mention. 'repeat' uses the full tool name at every mention. 'shorthand' defines the full name once, then uses "the tool" for subsequent references.

batch_size_format.title: CriticalRulesBatchSizeFormat
batch_size_format.description:
How the batch size value renders inline. 'plain' renders the number directly. 'bold' wraps in markdown bold. 'metadata' renders as a key-value label.
How a single value renders inline. 'backtick' wraps in code backticks. 'plain' renders as-is. 'bold' wraps in markdown bold. 'metadata' renders as a key-value label (e.g., "Batch size = N").

rule_separator.title: CriticalRulesRuleSeparator
rule_separator.description:
Content separator between individual critical rules. Controls visual density of the rule list. 'newline' for dense packing, 'double_newline' for visual separation between rules.
Content separator between repeated blocks. Declarative intent — the renderer maps each value to the actual string. 'newline' is a single line break. 'double_newline' is two line breaks (visual paragraph gap). 'horizontal_rule' is a markdown --- rule. 'blank_line' is an empty line. Extensible via union with fence types when more complex separators are needed.

instructions.title: InstructionsDisplay
instructions.description: Display formatting for the instructions section. Step header format, body container, mode separator, mode transition restriction, scaffolding tier thresholds, and recap format.

step_header_format.title: InstructionsStepHeaderFormat
step_header_format.description:
How step headers render. 'bold' uses markdown bold text inline. 'h3' uses a level-3 heading. 'h4' uses a level-4 heading.
How a sub-block heading renders. 'bold' uses markdown bold text inline. 'h3' uses a level-3 heading. 'h4' uses a level-4 heading. Section-level headings (H2) are invariant and not configurable.

step_body_container.title: InstructionsStepBodyContainer
step_body_container.description:
Visual container wrapping each step body. 'none' renders directly. 'blockquote' indents in a blockquote. 'bare_with_endmarker' appends an end marker for visual boundary closure.
Visual container wrapping a content body. 'none' renders content directly with no wrapping. 'blockquote' indents content in a markdown blockquote. 'bare_with_endmarker' renders content directly but appends an end marker for visual boundary closure.

step_mode_separator.title: InstructionsStepModeSeparator
step_mode_separator.description:
Separator between mode label and step header. Only rendered when both mode label and step header are present. The renderer maps the enum value to the actual separator string.
Inline separator between adjacent text elements. Declarative intent — the renderer maps each value to the actual string. 'dash' is an em dash with spaces ( — ). 'colon' is a colon with trailing space (: ). 'pipe' is a vertical bar with spaces ( | ). 'newline' is a single line break. 'double_newline' is two line breaks (visual paragraph gap).

instruction_mode_restrict_to_transition.title: InstructionsInstructionModeRestrictToTransition
instruction_mode_restrict_to_transition.description:
When true, consecutive steps with the same instruction mode suppress their mode labels. Only steps where the mode changes from the previous step display the label. When false, every step shows its mode label.
True or false value

scaffolding_tier_lightweight_activation_.title: InstructionsScaffoldingTierLightweightActivationThreshold
scaffolding_tier_lightweight_activation_.description:
Step count threshold for lightweight scaffolding tier activation. When structural_complexity_override is 'auto' and step count is at or below this value, lightweight tier is used.
Whole number value

scaffolding_tier_standard_activation_thr.title: InstructionsScaffoldingTierStandardActivationThreshold
scaffolding_tier_standard_activation_thr.description:
Step count threshold for standard scaffolding tier activation. When structural_complexity_override is 'auto' and step count is above lightweight but at or below this value, standard tier is used. Above this threshold, heavy tier activates.
Whole number value

instruction_mode_recap_format.title: InstructionsInstructionModeRecapFormat
instruction_mode_recap_format.description:
How the mode recap renders in the section closer. 'prose' summarizes as flowing text. 'tabular' presents as a structured mapping of step numbers to modes.
How a mode recap renders in section closers. 'prose' summarizes modes as flowing text. 'tabular' presents modes in a structured table or list mapping step numbers to their modes.

examples.title: ExamplesDisplay
examples.description: Display formatting for the examples section. Entry heading format, body container, and separators for entries and groups.

example_heading_format.title: ExamplesExampleHeadingFormat
example_heading_format.description:
How example entry headings render. 'bold' uses markdown bold (preserves boundaries without visual density for many entries). 'h3' or 'h4' uses heading levels.
How a sub-block heading renders. 'bold' uses markdown bold text inline. 'h3' uses a level-3 heading. 'h4' uses a level-4 heading. Section-level headings (H2) are invariant and not configurable.

example_body_container.title: ExamplesExampleBodyContainer
example_body_container.description:
Visual container for example entry content. 'bare_with_endmarker' renders directly with an end marker for boundary closure. 'blockquote' indents. 'none' renders directly.
Visual container wrapping a content body. 'none' renders content directly with no wrapping. 'blockquote' indents content in a markdown blockquote. 'bare_with_endmarker' renders content directly but appends an end marker for visual boundary closure.

example_separator.title: ExamplesExampleSeparator
example_separator.description:
Visual separator between example entries within a group. Used when entry headings are off (per-group data controls this).
Visual separator between repeated blocks. 'horizontal_rule' inserts a markdown horizontal rule (---) between items. 'none' uses only whitespace separation.

multi_group_separator.title: ExamplesMultiGroupSeparator
multi_group_separator.description:
Visual separator between example groups when multiple groups exist. 'horizontal_rule' inserts a markdown rule. 'none' uses whitespace only.
Visual separator between repeated blocks. 'horizontal_rule' inserts a markdown horizontal rule (---) between items. 'none' uses only whitespace separation.

constraints.title: ConstraintsDisplay
constraints.description: Display formatting for the constraints section. Enumeration format with threshold, visibility thresholds for closing reminder and count heading, must normalization, and polarity grouping threshold.

rules_format.title: ConstraintsRulesFormat
rules_format.description:
Format for rendering the constraint list. A single enum value uses that format always. A pair switches at the threshold — first format below, second format at or above the threshold.
Polymorphic format field. A plain string enum value means always use that format. A two-element array means threshold-based switching — first element above threshold, second at or below. Type tells behavior: string = unconditional, array = conditional.

rules_format_threshold.title: ConstraintsRulesFormatThreshold
rules_format_threshold.description:
Constraint count threshold for format switching when enumeration_format is a pair. Below this count the first format applies; at or above, the second format applies.
Whole number value

compliance_reminder_closing_visibility_t.title: ConstraintsComplianceReminderClosingVisibilityThreshold
compliance_reminder_closing_visibility_t.description:
Constraint count threshold for showing the closing compliance reminder. When constraint count is at or above this value and visibility is enabled, the reminder renders.
Whole number value

constraint_count_heading_visibility_thre.title: ConstraintsConstraintCountHeadingVisibilityThreshold
constraint_count_heading_visibility_thre.description:
Constraint count threshold for showing the count heading. When constraint count is at or above this value and visibility is enabled, the count heading renders.
Whole number value

must_vs_must_not_normalization.title: ConstraintsMustVsMustNotNormalization
must_vs_must_not_normalization.description:
How must/must-not phrasing is normalized across constraints. 'preserve_voice' keeps authored phrasing. Other values rewrite constraints to a consistent polarity style.
How MUST/MUST-NOT polarity is handled in constraint lists. 'preserve_voice' renders constraints as authored with no normalization. 'normalize_outliers' rewrites minority-polarity items to match the dominant voice. 'prefix_tags' prepends [MUST] or [MUST NOT] tags to each constraint regardless of authored voice.

polarity_grouping_activation_threshold.title: ConstraintsPolarityGroupingActivationThreshold
polarity_grouping_activation_threshold.description:
Constraint count threshold for activating polarity grouping. When constraint count reaches this value, constraints are split into must and must-not groups for clarity.
Whole number value

anti_patterns.title: AntiPatternsDisplay
anti_patterns.description: Display formatting for the anti-patterns section. Pattern list format.

patterns_format.title: AntiPatternsPatternsFormat
patterns_format.description:
Format for rendering the anti-pattern list. Controls whether entries use bare bullets, numbered items, or other list styles.
How anti-pattern entries render. 'bare_bullets' renders each pattern as a plain bullet point. 'bold_prohibition' renders with bold "Do not" prefix formatting to emphasize the prohibition.

success_criteria.title: SuccessCriteriaDisplay
success_criteria.description: Display formatting for the success criteria section. Evidence format with threshold-based switching.

evidence_format.title: SuccessCriteriaEvidenceFormat
evidence_format.description:
Format for rendering the evidence list. A single enum value uses that format always. A pair switches at the threshold — first format below, second format at or above the threshold.
Polymorphic format field. A plain string enum value means always use that format. A two-element array means threshold-based switching — first element above threshold, second at or below. Type tells behavior: string = unconditional, array = conditional.

evidence_format_threshold.title: SuccessCriteriaEvidenceFormatThreshold
evidence_format_threshold.description:
Evidence count threshold for format switching when evidence_format is a pair. Below this count the first format applies; at or above, the second format applies.
Whole number value

failure_criteria.title: FailureCriteriaDisplay
failure_criteria.description: Display formatting for the failure criteria section. Evidence format.

evidence_format.title: FailureCriteriaEvidenceFormat
evidence_format.description:
Format for rendering failure evidence lists. Unlike success criteria which uses threshold-based switching, failure evidence uses a single fixed format.
How a list of items renders visually. 'bulleted' uses dash or bullet markers. 'numbered' uses sequential integers. 'inline' joins items on one line with a separator. 'prose' flows items as natural language. 'bare' renders items with no markers or joining.

enum__list_format.title: ListFormat
enum__list_format.description: How a list of items renders visually. 'bulleted' uses dash or bullet markers. 'numbered' uses sequential integers. 'inline' joins items on one line with a separator. 'prose' flows items as natural language. 'bare' renders items with no markers or joining.

union__format_or_pair.title: FormatOrPair

oneOf.title: FormatPair
oneOf.description: Threshold-based format switching pair. First element is the format used when item count is above the threshold. Second element is the format used at or below the threshold. Example: [bulleted, inline] with threshold 3 means bulleted above 3, inline at or below 3.

union__format_or_pair.description: Polymorphic format field. A plain string enum value means always use that format. A two-element array means threshold-based switching — first element above threshold, second at or below. Type tells behavior: string = unconditional, array = conditional.

enum__separator_style.title: SeparatorStyle
enum__separator_style.description: Visual separator between repeated blocks. 'horizontal_rule' inserts a markdown horizontal rule (---) between items. 'none' uses only whitespace separation.

enum__body_container.title: BodyContainer
enum__body_container.description: Visual container wrapping a content body. 'none' renders content directly with no wrapping. 'blockquote' indents content in a markdown blockquote. 'bare_with_endmarker' renders content directly but appends an end marker for visual boundary closure.

enum__heading_format.title: HeadingFormat
enum__heading_format.description: How a sub-block heading renders. 'bold' uses markdown bold text inline. 'h3' uses a level-3 heading. 'h4' uses a level-4 heading. Section-level headings (H2) are invariant and not configurable.

enum__inline_format.title: InlineFormat
enum__inline_format.description: How a single value renders inline. 'backtick' wraps in code backticks. 'plain' renders as-is. 'bold' wraps in markdown bold. 'metadata' renders as a key-value label (e.g., "Batch size = N").
